description: Rules for `Event.extensions`, checked when an event is shaped as a CloudEvent (Go: ToCloudEvent). `extensions` is the wire object; `workspace_id` is the event's workspace id when present. A case without `error` must pass. Name: one or more of [a-z0-9] (length is not limited). Reserved attribute names (specversion id source type subject time datacontenttype dataschema data) fail with `reserved attribute name`; `workspaceid` and `kitorigin` are event-level reserved and are checked before the name rule for the same key. Value: string, bool, or an integer literal in [-2147483648, 2147483647]; 1.0, 1e3, null, arrays and objects are `unsupported extension value type`; an integer beyond that range is `integer out of range`. Entries are checked by ascending byte order of name and the first failure wins. `error` is the exact text. Decoding an event never applies these rules.
